Medi Assist India does not sell or distribute physical products, brands, or manufacturers. Instead, it operates as a Third-Party Administrator (TPA)
that processes health insurance claims, manages hospital networks, and administers health benefits for major insurance companies and corporate clients.
Medi Assist TPA
Partner Insurance Companies
Medi Assist works with over 30 leading public and private health insurance providers in India, administering policies and claims for brands such as:
Medi Assist
Private Insurers:
ICICI Lombard, HDFC ERGO, Tata AIG, Bajaj Allianz, and Acko.
Public/Govt Insurers:
New India Assurance, National Insurance, Oriental Insurance, and United India Insurance.
Specialized Health Insurers:
Niva Bupa, Care Health Insurance, and ManipalCigna.

Medi Assist Healthcare Services is India's leading health-benefits administrator and Third-Party Administrator (TPA)
. It develops intelligent digital technology platforms for healthcare claims processing and partners with over 32 major insurance companies and 28,500+ medical providers pan-India.
Medi Assist
Product Brands and Technology Platforms
MAtrix
: An AI-powered, automation-first core platform for intelligent claims adjudication, fast settlements, and real-time NHCX integration.
MAven Guard
: An advanced fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) detection system.
MAgnum
: A digital operational framework built for managing cashless hospitalization workflows.
MAven App
: A consumer and agent-facing mobile interface for tracking claims, accessing eCards, and managing policies.
Subsidiary Brands
: Medi Assist TPA, Paramount Health Services & Insurance TPA, and Mayfair We Care.
Medi Assist
